name: Aftermarket speakers
body: Straight swap into the OEM locations. Whether they draw anything extra depends entirely on whether there is an amplifier behind them.
watch: Head-unit powered means no new load at all — it is already counted in the head unit figure.
An amplifier is a different animal: it belongs on its own fused feed from the battery with a remote turn-on from the head unit, never on a fuse tap.
Door speakers need the loom routed through the door boot without stressing it.

elec.why: Passive on the head unit. Set an amplifier up separately in the load budget if one is fitted.

figs.c: Front door — trim removal for door speakers
